name: Harpies Threaten
summary: In the Charred Vale, Bloodfury harpies threaten the routes west of Sun Rock Retreat. Maggran Earthbinder sends Horde warriors to cull their growing ranks and protect travel through Stonetalon.

sections.title: Protectors of the Land
sections.body: Tauren at Sun Rock Retreat protect Stonetalon and its peaceful travelers. Maggran Earthbinder, the retreat’s elder leader, has watched the harpy numbers rise. The Bloodfury coven has spread through the scorched Charred Vale, harrying beasts and choking off routes. If their flocks keep growing, Sun Rock Retreat could be isolated.

sections.title: Scouring the Charred Vale
sections.body: The Charred Vale lies west of Sun Rock Retreat, a wasteland of ash, scorched earth, and smoldering trees left by catastrophic fires. Bloodfury harpies nest high in the charred remains of ancient woods and have made the vale their stronghold. Maggran sends Horde warriors into the hostile caldera to cull dozens of harpies: Bloodfury ambushers, slayers, and roguefeathers. Thinning the flock weakens the coven’s immediate grip on the vale and clears the way to confront its matriarchal lineage.

faq.q: Who gives the quest Harpies Threaten?
aliases: where to pick up harpies threaten
faq.answer: Maggran Earthbinder gives the request at Sun Rock Retreat in the Stonetalon Mountains, near the settlement’s central pool.

faq.q: Where are the Bloodfury harpies located?
faq.answer: Bloodfury harpies dwell throughout the Charred Vale, west of Sun Rock Retreat. A mountain path behind the retreat leads down into the vale.

faq.q: Why do the tauren want the harpies culled?
faq.answer: The tauren see themselves as guardians of Stonetalon’s natural balance. Maggran Earthbinder fears the Bloodfuries are spreading aggressively across Kalimdor, attacking innocents and blocking creatures from traveling freely.

faq.q: What comes after completing Harpies Threaten?
faq.answer: Completing this work unlocks Bloodfury Bloodline, where Maggran Earthbinder sends you to eliminate the Bloodfury coven’s ruling leadership.
Yes. Only Horde members can receive this work at Sun Rock Retreat.

faq.q: What kinds of harpies must be slain?
faq.answer: You must slay seven Bloodfury Harpies, seven Bloodfury Ambushers, seven Bloodfury Slayers, and seven Bloodfury Roguefeathers throughout the Charred Vale.

angles.text: As a tauren, culling the encroaching Bloodfuries is an honorable way to fulfill your ancestral promise to protect Kalimdor’s wilderness.
As Horde, clearing the skies over the Charred Vale strengthens your foothold at Sun Rock Retreat against Stonetalon’s dangerous wild factions.
As a druid, you see the Bloodfury coven’s twisted presence defiling the Charred Vale’s fragile, fire-ravaged ecology.
As a shaman, you answer Maggran Earthbinder’s call to purge aggressive defilers who upset the natural elemental balance.
